# Syntha, the RAG-as-a-Service platform

Syntha automatically delivers AI search and Generative Answers on top of your unstructured data, and provides knowledge in the form of trusted answers, in any language, and from any data.

Syntha allows you to customize your RAG pipeline and bring it directly to production.
With Syntha you can:

* Index any type of data in any language.
* Define your own retrieval strategy.
* Use any LLM to gain insights and knowledge from your data.
* Customize your prompt.
